evidenceClaims: FY2026 revenue was $707.0 million versus $501.0 million in FY2025, while net loss was $702.6 million and adjusted EBITDA $245.7 million.
At June 30, 2026 cash and cash equivalents were $5.896 billion and restricted cash $1.724 billion; management states liquidity is sufficient for at least 12 months under current plans.

FY2026 investing cash outflow was $4.723 billion and financing cash inflow $9.680 billion, including $7.238 billion debt-financing proceeds and $4.743 billion ordinary-share issuance proceeds before offsets.
Capital commitments were $13.810 billion, and the company explicitly expects substantial additional capital needs for AI cloud expansion.
Microsoft is a named five-year-average-term GPU-services customer across four Horizon tranches targeted for 2026 deployment; customer prepayments materially increased deferred revenue.
The filing identifies constrained GPU supply and long lead times as real dependencies and notes hardware/site commitments may precede financing or customer contracts.
